evals.prompt: Write hero copy for our landing page
evals.expected_output: A benefit-led headline with a clear subheadline, a specific call to action, and optional social proof. Speaks to the user outcome, not product features.

evals.prompt: Our pricing page converts poorly. Rewrite the copy
evals.expected_output: Reframes plans around customer value instead of feature lists, handles the top objections (is this worth it, what if I outgrow it), and makes the recommended plan visually and verbally obvious.
